records.findings_summary: Flag found via Reverse-engineered a custom RETRO-ASCII/punch-card protocol (ESC[ len payload crc8 ESC\), abused the 'write' command to corrupt the length field (state[0x100]) and the 'show' command to leak the stack (canary + PIE), then overflowed the stack with a ROP chain (pop rdi; ret -> system@plt) pointing rdi at '/bin/sh' stored in the writable .bss input buffer.: sun{the_future_is_now_today_well_wait_how_are_you_reading_this} | Evidence: Protocol: frames = ESC[ Lh Ll <L-byte body> <crc8> ESC\ where body[0] is a command (1=open,2=write,3=show,4=exit,5=system echo); crc8 = MSB-first poly 0x2f. ; .text:1289 checks key == 0x1337c35f; .text:167c sets state[0x100]=0x100 on success. ; .text:174c 'write' copies len-1 bytes into stack buffer (state, rbp-0x110) after checking idx<=state[0x100]; writing 257 bytes makes state[256]=crc byte, so forcing crc==0xff sets state[0x100]=0x1ff=511. ; .text:1810 'show' emits state[0..state[0x100]-1] -> leak of canary (offset 264), saved rbp (272), return addr into main (280 = pie+0x1a9f). ; ROP: pop rdi;ret @ pie+0x12aa, ret @ pie+0x101a, system@plt @ pie+0x10c0; '/bin/sh' placed in .bss input buffer (pie+0x4864+1) via the final exit frame body.
solution_steps: 用 IDA/objdump 逆向后确认这是一个自定义帧协议（ESC[ len body crc8 ESC\）的菜单程序，命令: 1=插入钥匙(open)、2=写(state)、3=显示(state)、4=退出、5=system(echo)。
open 需 key=0x1337c35f，成功后 state[0x100]=0x100(256)。
write 处理器把 len-1 字节拷进栈缓冲 state(rbp-0x110)，仅检查 idx<=state[0x100]；发送 257 字节的 write，使 state[256]=crc 字节，爆破数据让 crc==0xff，则 state[0x100]=0x1ff=511。
用 show 泄露 state[0..510]，得到 canary(偏移264)、saved rbp(272)、返回地址(280, =pie+0x1a9f) 从而得到 PIE 基址。
第二次 write（idx 可达511）覆盖 canary 与返回地址，布置 ROP: pop rdi;ret(pie+0x12aa) -> .bss 中 "/bin/sh"(pie+0x4865) -> ret(pie+0x101a, 对齐) -> system@plt(pie+0x10c0)。" 用带 "/bin/sh" 的 exit 帧(命令4)将字符串写入 .bss，然后触发返回。
拿到 shell 后 cat /flag* 得到 sun{the_future_is_now_today_well_wait_how_are_you_reading_this}。
evidence: Protocol: frames = ESC[ Lh Ll <L-byte body> <crc8> ESC\ where body[0] is a command (1=open,2=write,3=show,4=exit,5=system echo); crc8 = MSB-first poly 0x2f.
.text:1289 checks key == 0x1337c35f; .text:167c sets state[0x100]=0x100 on success.

.text:174c 'write' copies len-1 bytes into stack buffer (state, rbp-0x110) after checking idx<=state[0x100]; writing 257 bytes makes state[256]=crc byte, so forcing crc==0xff sets state[0x100]=0x1ff=511.
.text:1810 'show' emits state[0..state[0x100]-1] -> leak of canary (offset 264), saved rbp (272), return addr into main (280 = pie+0x1a9f).
ROP: pop rdi;ret @ pie+0x12aa, ret @ pie+0x101a, system@plt @ pie+0x10c0; '/bin/sh' placed in .bss input buffer (pie+0x4864+1) via the final exit frame body.
Local shell confirmed (uid=0) then remote run returned: sun{the_future_is_now_today_well_wait_how_are_you_reading_this} with uid=1337(homemaker).
Platform submission returned CORRECT for this exact flag.
